*[Carga]: A load: a spreadsheet (or a zip with a spreadsheet and arquivos/) uploaded through the dashboard that becomes a batch of records in a project's queue; recorded in the Cargas table.
*[carga]: A load: a spreadsheet (or a zip with a spreadsheet and arquivos/) uploaded through the dashboard that becomes a batch of records in a project's queue; recorded in the Cargas table.
*[Keychain]: The table holding each project's target-system credentials, read by the automation at runtime.
*[keychain]: The table holding each project's target-system credentials, read by the automation at runtime.
*[Projeto]: A project: one automation in projetos//, discovered by the dashboard through project.json and run as a child process.
*[projeto]: A project: one automation in projetos//, discovered by the dashboard through project.json and run as a child process.
*[Queue]: A project's table (class Queue, subclass of BaseQueue) with one record per item to process and its resultsstatus.
*[queue]: A project's table (class Queue, subclass of BaseQueue) with one record per item to process and its resultsstatus.
*[Socket]: A socket control file in the project folder through which dashboard and automation exchange commands, status and questions.
*[socket]: A socket control file in the project folder through which dashboard and automation exchange commands, status and questions.
*[Template]: A project's template. file, downloadable in the dashboard, defining the expected load layout.
